title: Wide Perturbation Around Round-2 Optimum with 0.05nm Resolution
scientific_hypothesis: The round-3 score regression (0.9829 to 0.9114) resulted from over-constrained ±8nm perturbation bounds that prevented the optimizer from escaping local minima. Widening bounds to ±25nm while maintaining 0.05nm thickness resolution should recover performance headroom toward the round-2 optimum.
design_principle: Gradient-based thickness optimization with expanded search volume around a verified high-performing baseline, preserving the 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 topology that achieved 0.9829 target score.
proposed_topology: 24 finite layers: TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, incident medium air
design_variables: all 24 layer thicknesses with ±25nm perturbation from round-2 best candidate
manufacturing_considerations: 0.05nm resolution enforceable by modern deposition controllers
thickness bounds prevent negative or unphysically thick layers
theory_basis: Quarter-wave baseline initialization provides physically motivated starting point for local optimization
Needle optimization principles support iterative thickness refinement around verified optima
expected_advantages: Wider search volume allows escape from round-3 local minimum
0.05nm resolution eliminates grid-snapping artifacts per feedback directive
Seeding from round-2 optimum preserves verified high-performance configuration
known_risks: Wider bounds may increase optimization iterations needed for convergence
May not fully recover round-2 performance if regression caused by different mechanism
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with alternating TiO2 and SiO2 layers. Initialize thicknesses from round-2 best candidate: [45.47401021074687, 66.26173499525001, 100.00522588748122, 115.65875644661014, 54.38998478110777, 104.86842467931939, 69.42707305793404, 114.8984723788802, 69.97784868897342, 102.32524839263667, 64.44702856605194, 116.99332848603837, 56.98508016440016, 108.17496606300708, 51.15280225329831, 83.29092690995319, 45.84935397614872, 81.30484984232174, 51.661323791498404, 104.19531386036509, 56.845992345901784, 92.36958384345769, 39.97785121802839, 156.38365648117548] nm. Apply perturbation bounds of ±25nm from these seed values with minimum 0.05nm thickness resolution. Evaluate at 45 degree incidence, unpolarized light, wavelength bands 450-650nm (target high reflectance) and 700-1000nm (target high transmittance). Use gradient-based optimizer with soft-margin penalty for bound violations instead of hard clipping. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Round-3 score regression (0.9829 to 0.9114) attributed to over-constrained ±8nm perturbation bounds. This route widens bounds to ±25nm while preserving round-2 optimum seeding and implementing 0.05nm resolution per feedback directives.
